messages:
sara: Heads-up — quant-eval CI failing during artifact ingest on master. failing step is `ingest-manifest` with a checksum mismatch from S3 after the new metadata enrichment hook landed this morning.

deepak: ugh. any logs?

sara: paste from job log:
```
ERROR: UploadError: Multipart upload completed but ETag mismatch
Computed MD5: 6b2a9f3c4e5d1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d
S3 ETag:   "3f9e2a7b6c5d4e3f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b-3"
Manifest: /evals/quant/2026-03-18/manifest.json.gz
```

maria: that `-3` on the etag means multipart upload; looks like the content we uploaded differs bytewise. we added `quant_bins` and `scale_hint` in the post-collector enrichment lambda — might be ordering or different gzip headers.

ingest-bot: uploader-v2.7.1 starting multipart upload manifest.json.gz (parts=3) :package:

ken: two quick suspects: we changed dict serialization in the enrichment (Py3.11 dict insertion is preserved but process-level differences can change ordering), and the gzip header includes mtime by default which can differ across runs.

deepak: good call. can we repro locally? run the same pipeline and compare raw bytes before upload. also check if we accidentally used `gzip.GzipFile(mtime=int(time.time()))` anywhere.

sara: i ran a local ingest with the same sample set. bytes differ only in two places — gzip header mtime and a reordered metadata object inside the per-sample JSON.

maria: easy fix: use canonical JSON + deterministic gzip options. e.g. `json.dumps(obj, separators=("," : ":"), sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')` then `gzip.compress(data, mtime=0)` so ETag stable.

ken: agreed. also add a unit test that does roundtrip: serialize -> compress -> compute md5 -> decompress -> parse and assert equality. put it behind `make test-ingest`.

deepak: will open a small PR to standardize serialization and set mtime=0. also will add a CI job that verifies manifest ETag matches expected for a fixed sample bundle.

qa-bot: FYI — flakiness alert: quant-evals CI history shows 3 fails in last 24h (builds 8321, 8329, 8330). tagging as flaky until fixed.

sara: rollback plan if needed: pin enrichment hook to old schema (v2) which is deterministic, and re-run failing releases. but prefer quick patch first.

maria: note for backfill: existing uploaded manifests are likely fine; only risk is new runs producing incompatible etags which will be rejected by downstream consumers expecting stable manifests. we should add a migration script to re-upload canonicalized manifests for any run in the last 48h if CI was green.

ken: i'll review the PR. deepak, please include a brief changelog entry and the new test command. also add a short note in the ingest README about canonicalization.

deepak: on it. PR incoming in ~30m. marking this thread P1 for the release.

sara: thanks — good triage. :thumbsup:

ingest-bot: deploy pipeline detected: uploader-v2.7.2 -> canary started (env=staging)

qa-bot: re-run queued quant-evals now that canary is up: `make ci-quant-e2e`

sara: I'll kick off the re-run and watch logs.
